messages:
Maya: flagging a mobile UX regression — on narrow Android phones the right-side table overflow indicator overlaps the floating sidebar handle. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/overflow-handle.png :frowning:
Dev: device/browser? density?
Maya: Pixel 4a, Android 12, Chrome. Viewport ~360w. Table uses horizontal scroll for long IDs and an overflow chevron shows on the right. When sidebar peek handle is also shown it sits on top of that chevron and users can't reliably reach the table scroller.
Omar: analytics show a small bump in mobile "open row" failures in that cohort last 3 days — could be same.
Priya: accessibility concerns: overlapping interactive controls can confuse keyboard navigation and screen reader focus order. Also visual contrast of the handle vs table background is borderline at low brightness.
Dev: two fast options: (A) collapse the peek handle into a single 8px edge stripe (with expanded hit area) and shift it under the safe-area inset, or (B) hide the peek handle whenever a horizontally scrollable container is focused or has pointer hover. Thoughts?
Evan: also re: copy — currently the overflow chevron tooltip says "More" which is ambiguous on mobile. Suggest "Show row actions" for clarity.
Maya: prefer A + copy change. Keep the handle visually minimal but make it discoverable: small visible stripe with a 44x44 hit target via ::before pseudo-element.
Priya: ok if we do A ensure stripe has aria-hidden=false when focusable and a descriptive accessible name like "Open sidebar". If we keep hidden-on-hover logic, ensure keyboard users can still access it via a focusable button in the header.
Dev: CSS I'll try locally:
```css
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .peek-handle { width: 8px; background: var(--accent); position: absolute; left: env(safe-area-inset-left); height: 100%; }
  .peek-handle::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 44px; height: 44px; position: absolute; left: -18px; }
  .table-overflow .chevron { right: 24px; }
}
```
Dev: and JS change: when measuring horizontal scrollable containers we add `data-has-h-scroll` and the handle will avoid overlaying elements with that attribute. Also will ensure the handle is removed from DOM when a table row action menu is open.
Maya: also can we align the chevron color with brand tokens for contrast. I'll add a small token request in figma.
Priya: quick a11y test requested: VoiceOver & TalkBack focus order check, and keyboard nav where the handle is focused with tab. Also document the accessible name change for the tooltip.
Omar: schedule a 15m sync to validate staging after PR? Tomorrow 9:30am PT works for me.
swipe-bot: test note — added automated UI test (mobile-overlap-avoidance) to staging runs (build 2026.03.21-12).
Dev: opening a draft PR now: https://git.redwood/PR/4310 (WIP) — will include CSS snippet, aria updates, and copy tweak.
Maya: great — thanks all. Leaving a quick design note with token and two layout variants. :sparkles:
